source: icsg v13 values.csv. Scandinavia, loaded from the 2005 yearbook: Mining, Smelting, Refining and Semi rows 1995-2004, Cathode_Pool 1996-2004. Sweden: MESC from 1996 (2005 yearbook); Mining, Smelting, Refining and Semi from 2004 (2014 yearbook); Cathode_Pool from 2005
comment: Until 2003 only Sweden's LME stock changes (MESC 1996-2003) are reported as Sweden, so its flows sit inside Scandinavia. 2004, the year after year_to, is the handover year: ICSG publishes Scandinavia and its members, so 2004 states Sweden's share of each Scandinavia series, and the 2004 aggregate republishes its members. Finland and Norway also report from 2004 and map to ROW, which is never a hub (ADR 0027). #67, #73, #74
